description: The line plot, titled "Finetuning for different r, WikiHow," illustrates the ROUGE-1 score as a function of the logarithm of r (log r) for four different model configurations on the WikiHow dataset. The x-axis represents log r, ranging from 0 to 9 with a logarithmic scale, while the y-axis shows the ROUGE-1 score, ranging from 0 to 35. The plot displays four distinct lines: "MBart + LoRA" (red circles), "T5 + AdaLoRA" (green squares), "MBart + AdaLoRA" (orange triangles), and "MBart + LoRA" (purple diamonds). The "T5 + AdaLoRA" model consistently achieves the highest ROUGE-1 scores, starting at approximately 23.0 when log r = 0 and increasing to a peak of about 35.8 at log r = 4, remaining relatively stable at this high level. The "MBart + AdaLoRA" model shows a steady increase from a score of about 12.2 at log r = 0 to a final score of approximately 33.6 at log r = 9. The "MBart + LoRA" model starts at a low score of around 5.0 at log r = 0, rises to a peak of about 27.1 at log r = 4, and then gradually declines to approximately 26.9 at log r = 9. The "MBart + LoRA" model (purple) begins at a score of about 12.2 at log r = 0, drops to a minimum of approximately 5.0 at log r = 1, and then rises to a plateau of about 27.0 from log r = 2 to 9.
